responsibility: Implements the RTL forward-propagation passes using RTL SSA information. It follows single-def uses to substitute defining sources into later uses, simplify resulting expressions, improve memory addresses when profitable, propagate register copies, and eliminate unnecessary paradoxical subregs, while being conservative around loops and nonlocal gotos; the file also owns the two pass variants that run full propagation and address-focused propagation, plus their SSA/dominance/loop setup and teardown.
